name: Spotify Volume Slider Enlarge
description: Makes the volume slider wider and easier to control with TV remote

params.css: [class*='volume-bar'], [data-testid='volume-bar'] { width: 160px !important; min-width: 160px !important; } [class*='volume-bar'] [class*='progress-bar'], [data-testid='volume-bar'] [class*='progress-bar'] { height: 8px !important; border-radius: 4px !important; } [class*='volume-bar'] button, [data-testid='volume-bar'] button { transform: scale(1.5) !important; } [class*='volume-bar'] [class*='handle'], [data-testid='volume-bar'] [class*='handle'] { width: 18px !important; height: 18px !important; }
